part.text: {"imageReviewed":true,"scores":{"silhouette":3,"palette":3,"shapeLanguage":3,"valueStructure":3,"sceneFit":2,"craft":3},"features":{"bale":true,"bands":true,"ends":false},"blockers":["bale: straw identity unreadable at 320x180, lit faces read muddy brown wood rather than warm tan-ochre straw","ends: end faces are not clearly defined, side views show the same undifferentiated brown slab as the sides","bands: two timber bands merge into body segmentation and count is not reliably readable in diagonal and sunset views","silhouette: diagonal yaws show a stepped, notched outline instead of a single soft-edged squat rectangle","sceneFit: bale is not findable as a hay bale in the signed farm at actual game scale and reads as ground debris"],"fixes":["Lighten bale to warm tan-ochre dirt.hi and increase hue/value separation from timber bands without strands or hatch marks","Give end faces a distinct bale-coloured uninterrupted face with a readable bevel edge separate from side faces","Make bands continuous wraps over top and ends, broad enough that two bands count at 0, 45 and 90 degrees in daytime","Remove band protrusion steps so diagonal silhouette stays a clean rounded rectangle","Increase contrast against grass and path so the bale reads in-farm while keeping the specced 1x0.7x0.6 footprint"],"action":"refine-code"}
